decks.title: ACT: Science Reasoning Terms
decks.description: For ACT learners practicing scientific reasoning: experimental design, data interpretation, graphs, measurement, and common science terms. Original practice vocabulary, not official test questions.

decks.title: AP Biology: Core Terms
decks.description: For AP Biology students: original definitions and examples covering cellular chemistry, energy, heredity, evolution, and ecology. Built for concept recall and connections across units.

decks.title: AP Calculus AB: Rules and Formulas
decks.description: For AP Calculus AB students reviewing limits, derivatives, integrals, motion, and volume. Formulas include key hypotheses and domain restrictions; trigonometric inputs use radians.

decks.title: AP Chemistry: Core Concepts
decks.description: For AP Chemistry students reviewing atomic structure, bonding, reactions, kinetics, equilibrium, acids and bases, thermodynamics and electrochemistry through concise concept questions.

decks.title: AP Human Geography: Terms
decks.description: For AP Human Geography students reviewing spatial thinking, population, culture, politics, agriculture, development and cities through original definitions and short examples.

decks.title: AP Psychology: Key Terms
decks.description: For AP Psychology learners: research, brain and behavior, cognition, learning, development, social psychology, and clinical concepts through definitions and examples. For clinical material, verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: AP Statistics: Concepts and Formulas
decks.description: For AP Statistics students reviewing data analysis, study design, probability, sampling distributions, confidence intervals, and hypothesis tests. Original concept and formula prompts with conditions stated.

decks.title: AP US Government: Terms, Cases, Amendments
decks.description: For AP US Government learners reviewing institutions, participation, constitutional principles, all 27 amendments, and landmark cases. Historical holdings are distinguished from later changes; verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: AP US History: Key Events and Terms
decks.description: For AP US History learners reviewing major events, constitutional developments, movements, and turning points. Paired concept and chronology prompts support recall across the course.

decks.title: AP World History: Key Terms
decks.description: For AP World History learners: key states, people, beliefs, exchanges and transformations from c. 1200 to the present, with selected earlier foundations for context. Original concise explanations for independent review.

decks.title: Arabic: Alphabet and Forms
decks.description: For beginners learning the 28 Arabic letters in four positions. Includes names, transliteration, formal sounds, and joining limits. Connector strokes illustrate forms; examples show words containing each letter.

decks.title: Arabic (MSA): 300 Most Common Words
decks.description: For beginners: common Modern Standard Arabic vocabulary with readable romanization, English meanings and original examples. Verbs use the citation past form; this is a practical selection, not a fixed corpus ranking.

decks.title: Art History: Movements and Artists
decks.description: For beginners connecting major art movements, techniques, artists, and landmark works. Primarily a European and American survey, with introductory Japanese, Chinese, and South Asian topics; movement labels are broad guides.

decks.title: ASL: Fingerspelling and 100 Core Signs
decks.description: For beginners: 26 fingerspelled letters and 100 everyday ASL concepts in original text descriptions. Use your dominant hand unless stated; regional variants exist. Practice with fluent signers and visual demonstrations.

decks.title: Astronomy: Solar System and Stars
decks.description: For beginning astronomy learners: planets, moons, small bodies, seasons, eclipses, the Sun, and stellar life cycles. Focuses on durable concepts rather than changing discovery counts.

decks.title: AWS: Cloud Practitioner Services and Terms
decks.description: For Cloud Practitioner learners: core AWS services, security responsibilities, architecture, operations, and cost concepts. Examples emphasize service selection; confirm current exam scope and product details in AWS documentation.

decks.title: Bar Exam: Contracts and UCC Article 2
decks.description: For bar candidates reviewing general U.S. common-law contracts and traditional UCC Article 2 rules. State enactments and exceptions vary; verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: Bar Exam: Federal Rules of Evidence
decks.description: For bar examinees reviewing federal evidence rule numbers, admissibility, witnesses, hearsay, and authentication. Plain-English study summaries; verify with current guidelines and the governing rule text.

decks.title: Bar Exam: Torts Rules
decks.description: For US bar learners reviewing majority and traditional tort rules, elements, and defenses. State variations are flagged; verify with current guidelines and the law tested in your jurisdiction.

decks.title: Biology: Cell Structure and Function
decks.description: For beginning biology students studying cell membranes, organelles, transport, energy conversion, cytoskeleton, signaling, and division. Focuses on standard foundational cell biology.

decks.title: CFA Level I: Formulas and Definitions
decks.description: For CFA Level I learners reviewing core finance formulas and definitions, including valuation, statistics, accounting ratios, and risk. Original study aid; notation, timing, and model assumptions are stated on each card.

decks.title: Chemistry: Polyatomic Ions and Common Compounds
decks.description: For chemistry students learning common polyatomic ions, ionic formulas and naming rules. Plain-text formulas use digits for atom counts and caret notation for ionic charges.

decks.title: Chess: Openings, Tactics, Terms
decks.description: For beginning chess players learning opening names, tactical patterns, notation and core strategic terms. Original examples use standard chess positions and algebraic move notation.

decks.title: CompTIA A+: Hardware, OS, Troubleshooting
decks.description: For A+ learners reviewing hardware, networking, operating systems, security and troubleshooting fundamentals. Original concept questions, not exam items; verify with current guidelines for electrical safety and device servicing.

decks.title: CompTIA Security+: Concepts and Acronyms
decks.description: For Security+ learners reviewing foundational security concepts, acronyms, threats, controls, cloud responsibility, and risk. Original study prompts; no claim of complete coverage of a specific exam version.

decks.title: Cooking: Techniques, Ratios, Conversions
decks.description: For beginner home cooks: essential techniques, flexible culinary ratios, US volume conversions and basic food safety. Ratios are starting points, not universal recipes; verify with current guidelines for safety advice.

decks.title: CPA: FAR Key Concepts
decks.description: For CPA FAR learners reviewing US GAAP financial reporting, calculations, transactions, and introductory nonprofit and governmental accounting. General study concepts; verify with current guidelines and exam blueprints.

decks.title: CS: Data Structures and Algorithms
decks.description: For intermediate CS learners reviewing data structures, algorithms, correctness, and complexity. Bounds state important assumptions; n is item count, V vertices, E edges, and h tree height unless otherwise specified.

decks.title: Earth Science: Rocks, Weather, Plate Tectonics
decks.description: For beginning Earth science learners: rocks and minerals, geological processes, plate tectonics, water, weather and climate, explained through short concept questions.

decks.title: Economics: Micro and Macro Principles
decks.description: For learners reviewing economics: scarcity, markets, incentives, market failures, firms, national output, employment, prices, and policy. Definitions are paired with applied examples.

decks.title: English: 200 Common Idioms
decks.description: For intermediate English learners studying 200 common idioms. Original definitions and example sentences explain figurative meanings in everyday contexts.

decks.title: Literature: Authors and Major Works
decks.description: For literature beginners: match major novels, plays, poems, and story collections with their authors. Brief context distinguishes similar titles; traditional and complex attributions are noted.

decks.title: Film: Terms and Techniques
decks.description: For beginning film viewers and makers: 100 terms for framing, camera movement, editing, lighting, sound and production, each with a plain-language definition and a practical example.

decks.title: First Aid and CPR: Steps and Facts
decks.description: For beginners reviewing adult CPR, AEDs, bleeding, burns, and emergency recognition. General guidance, not a substitute for practical training; follow current local guidelines and verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: French: 120 Essential Verbs
decks.description: For beginning French learners: 120 useful infinitives, English meanings, and je, tu, and il present-tense forms with short French examples.

decks.title: French: 500 Most Common Words
decks.description: For beginners: 500 common French words in approximate frequency order, with noun gender and original examples. Latin-script headwords also serve as romanization; ranks vary by corpus.

decks.title: French: Travel Phrases
decks.description: For beginning travelers: 100 French phrases for transport, hotels, meals, shopping, and help, with register notes. French already uses Latin script; the answer repeats its written form before the meaning.

decks.title: Biology: Genetics and Inheritance
decks.description: For biology learners studying Mendelian crosses, chromosomes, linkage, molecular variation, and population genetics. Includes simplified inheritance models; verify with current guidelines for any clinical application.

decks.title: German: 120 Essential Verbs
decks.description: For beginning German learners: common infinitives with English meanings, present-tense ich, du, and er forms, usage examples, and separable prefixes.

decks.title: German: 500 Most Common Words
decks.description: For beginners learning frequent German vocabulary: 500 useful word forms with original examples. Nouns include grammatical gender and plural forms; vocabulary selection is frequency-informed, not a universal ranking.

decks.title: German: Travel Phrases
decks.description: For beginning travelers: complete phrases for greetings, transport, lodging, meals, shopping, and asking for help. English meanings explain when to use each phrase.

decks.title: Git: Commands and Concepts
decks.description: For Git beginners learning snapshots, staging, branches, collaboration, and recovery. Commands use uppercase placeholders such as PATH; cards explain when an operation discards changes or rewrites history.

decks.title: GMAT: Quant Formulas and Rules
decks.description: For GMAT learners reviewing arithmetic, algebra, number properties and word-problem rules. Original prompts emphasize assumptions, useful formulas and common calculation traps.

decks.title: GRE: 500 High-Frequency Words
decks.description: For GRE learners building advanced reading vocabulary: 500 commonly studied words with concise definitions and original examples. This is a curated study selection, not a measured frequency ranking.

decks.title: Mythology: Greek and Roman Gods and Myths
decks.description: For beginners exploring Greek and Roman deities, heroes, monsters, and major stories. Mythic traditions vary; these original summaries identify common versions and distinguish Greek and Roman names.

decks.title: Hindi: Devanagari Script
decks.description: For beginners reading Hindi: vowels, consonants, nukta letters, vowel signs, conjuncts, digits, and useful words. Romanization uses macrons for long vowels; actual speech often drops inherent a.

decks.title: Anatomy: 206 Bones
decks.description: For anatomy learners: the conventional 206 adult bones, counted individually by side and digit, with location and a notable feature. Counts vary with fusion and accessory bones; verify with current guidelines for clinical use.

decks.title: Anatomy: Major Muscles
decks.description: For anatomy students reviewing 50 major muscles through separate origin, insertion, and action prompts. Attachments are concise summaries of standard anatomy; verify with current guidelines for clinical use.

decks.title: Physiology: Body Systems
decks.description: For students reviewing human physiology: core mechanisms in the nervous, endocrine, cardiovascular, respiratory, renal, digestive and reproductive systems. Educational review; verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: Italian: 120 Essential Verbs
decks.description: For beginning Italian learners: 120 everyday infinitives with English meanings and short Italian sentences showing natural usage. Italian already uses the Latin alphabet.

decks.title: Italian: 500 Most Common Words
decks.description: For beginners learning 500 common Italian words, with English meanings, grammatical labels and original examples. Latin-script headwords serve as romanization; selection is not a fixed corpus ranking.

decks.title: Japanese: Everyday Phrases
decks.description: For beginners learning everyday Japanese greetings, requests, and travel phrases. Kana prompts include romaji, English meanings, politeness notes, and usage examples.

decks.title: Japanese: Hiragana and Katakana
decks.description: For beginners learning to read Japanese: 71 hiragana and 71 katakana, including voiced and p-sounds, with romaji and example words. Long vowels are written with doubled vowels.

decks.title: Japanese: N5 Kanji (80)
decks.description: For beginning Japanese learners: 80 common kanji often studied toward N5, with selected on/kun readings and example words. JLPT does not publish an official kanji list.

decks.title: Japanese: JLPT N5 Core Vocabulary
decks.description: For beginning Japanese learners: kana vocabulary, romaji, English meanings, and simple examples for N5-level study. A practical selection, not an official JLPT vocabulary list.

decks.title: JavaScript: Language Essentials
decks.description: For beginning JavaScript developers learning values, scope, functions, collections, objects, modules and asynchronous code. Examples are plain text and focus on established language behavior.

decks.title: Korean: Everyday Phrases
decks.description: For beginners practicing Korean greetings, travel requests, and daily conversation. Each answer gives romanization, English meaning, and a politeness note.

decks.title: Korean: Hangul Letters and Syllables
decks.description: For new Korean readers: consonants, all 21 vowels, and common open and closed syllable blocks with examples. Revised Romanization is a reading aid; final consonants can change sound in connected speech.

decks.title: Korean: 500 Most Common Words
decks.description: For beginning Korean learners: 500 high-utility words and expressions with romanization, English meanings and short usage examples. This is a practical selection, not a ranked frequency list.

decks.title: English: Latin and Greek Roots
decks.description: For intermediate English learners: common Latin and Greek roots and affixes, each with its meaning and three related words. Meanings are historical guides, not complete definitions of every derivative.

decks.title: Linux: Command Line Essentials
decks.description: For Linux beginners using Bash and common GNU utilities: navigation, files, text processing, pipes, permissions, processes, networking, and archives. Examples explain commands without executing them; optional tools are identified.

decks.title: LSAT: Logical Reasoning Concepts
decks.description: For LSAT learners reviewing argument structure, assumptions, common flaws, quantifiers, and conditional logic. Original conceptual prompts build reasoning vocabulary without reproducing exam questions.

decks.title: Mandarin: Everyday Phrases
decks.description: For beginners: 100 everyday Mandarin phrases in simplified characters, with tone-marked pinyin, English meanings, and examples for greetings, travel, shopping, and asking for help.

decks.title: Mandarin: HSK 1-2 Vocabulary
decks.description: For beginners: the 300-word vocabulary scope of the legacy six-level HSK 1-2 syllabus, with simplified characters, tone-marked pinyin, English meanings and original examples. Not the expanded HSK 3.0 syllabus.

decks.title: MCAT: Biochemistry Essentials
decks.description: For MCAT learners reviewing amino acids, proteins, enzymes, metabolism, nucleic acids, and lab methods. Educational biochemical principles; verify with current guidelines for clinical applications.

decks.title: MCAT: Physics Formulas
decks.description: For MCAT learners reviewing mechanics, fluids, thermodynamics, electricity, waves, optics, and atomic physics. Equations include assumptions and symbol meanings; verify with current guidelines for exam scope.

decks.title: MCAT: Psych/Soc Terms
decks.description: For MCAT learners reviewing psychology and sociology through original definitions and examples: learning, cognition, behavior, research, social interaction, and inequality. Clinical terms are educational; verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: Medical Terminology: Roots, Prefixes, Suffixes
decks.description: For health-science learners: medical roots, prefixes, and suffixes paired with word-decoding practice and examples. Meanings depend on context; verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: Microbiology: Bacteria, Viruses, Fungi
decks.description: For biology and health-science learners studying microbial structures, growth, genetics, viruses, fungi, and laboratory concepts. Educational consensus only; verify with current guidelines for clinical applications.

decks.title: Morse Code and NATO Alphabet
decks.description: For beginners learning International Morse letters A–Z and digits 0–9, plus all 26 NATO spelling words. Dots and dashes show signals; NATO words spell letters and are not Morse sounds.

decks.title: Music Theory: Intervals, Scales, Chords, Terms
decks.description: For beginners studying Western music notation and tonal theory: intervals, scales, chords, meter, rhythm, dynamics, texture, and form. Examples use letter names and standard twelve-tone equal-tempered semitone counts.

decks.title: NCLEX: Lab Values and Vital Signs
decks.description: For nursing exam learners reviewing adult lab values, vital signs, and interpretation in common US reporting units. Ranges vary between references and laboratories; verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: NCLEX: Pharmacology Drug Classes
decks.description: For nursing students reviewing 50 drug classes: generic examples, mechanisms, major adverse effects and nursing priorities. Educational review; verify with current guidelines and product-specific orders.

decks.title: Networking: Ports, Protocols, OSI Model
decks.description: For networking learners: common service ports, transport behavior, addressing, routing, security and OSI layers. Ports are conventional defaults, not proof of a service; real deployments may use different ports.

decks.title: Nutrition: Vitamins, Minerals, Macronutrients
decks.description: For beginners learning nutrition: macronutrients, vitamins, minerals, food sources, and basic nutrient functions. General education rather than individualized diet advice; verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: Chemistry: All 118 Elements
decks.description: For beginning chemistry learners: all 118 symbols, names, atomic numbers, groups or inner-transition series, and one fact each. Lanthanoids and actinoids use series labels to avoid disputed group-3 placement.

decks.title: Personal Finance: Terms and Rules of Thumb
decks.description: For beginners learning budgeting, saving, borrowing, investing, and insurance terms in a US context. Rules of thumb are flexible examples, not personal advice; verify with current guidelines and account terms.

decks.title: Pharmacology: Top 200 Drugs (generic)
decks.description: For health-science learners: 200 commonly encountered US generic medicines, with class, a common use and a key caution. A study selection, not a ranked prescribing list or dosing guide; verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: Philosophy: Thinkers and Key Ideas
decks.description: For philosophy learners: major questions, arguments and thinkers across ethics, knowledge, reality and political thought, including selected Asian and African traditions. Concise summaries introduce debates without claiming to settle them.

decks.title: Physics: Formulas and Constants
decks.description: For intermediate physics students reviewing mechanics, fluids, heat, waves, optics, circuits, fields, and modern physics. Formulas define variables and state important idealizations; constants use SI units.

decks.title: Portuguese: 120 Essential Verbs
decks.description: For beginners learning 120 useful Portuguese infinitives, with English meanings and translated example sentences. Examples mainly follow Brazilian usage; Portuguese already uses the Latin alphabet.

decks.title: Portuguese (Brazil): 500 Most Common Words
decks.description: For beginners learning Brazilian Portuguese: 500 useful common words and expressions with usage examples. A curated study selection, not an exact frequency ranking; Latin-script forms are repeated in answers.

decks.title: Psychology 101: Core Concepts
decks.description: For introductory psychology learners: research, brain and behavior, perception, learning, memory, development, personality, and social psychology. Clinical entries are brief concepts, not diagnostic checklists; verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: Python: Syntax and Standard Library
decks.description: For Python beginners using Python 3.10 or later: syntax, collections, functions, exceptions, files, and common standard-library tools. Each answer includes a short code example; file examples assume suitable local files.

decks.title: Regex: Patterns and Syntax
decks.description: For developers practicing regex syntax, matching, groups, assertions, and common pitfalls. Examples use JavaScript unless stated otherwise; engine differences are identified explicitly.

decks.title: Russian: Cyrillic Alphabet
decks.description: For beginners learning all 33 Russian letters, with sound cues and 33 example words. Romanization is a reading aid, not exact pronunciation; stress and vowel reduction affect speech.

decks.title: Russian: 300 Most Common Words
decks.description: For beginners: 300 common Russian words and a few fixed expressions, with English meanings, transliteration, and examples. This is a curated selection rather than an exact frequency ranking; transliteration does not mark stress.

decks.title: SAT: 500 Vocabulary Words
decks.description: For SAT learners building reading precision: 500 academic and literary words with concise original definitions, parts of speech and example sentences. This is independent vocabulary practice, not an official test word list.

decks.title: Spanish: 120 Essential Verbs
decks.description: For beginning Spanish learners: 120 common infinitives, English meanings, and present-tense yo, tú, and él forms, with short usage examples.

decks.title: Spanish: 500 Most Common Words
decks.description: For beginners: 500 frequent Spanish word forms in subtitle-frequency order, with English meanings, grammar labels and original example sentences. Accented variants are preserved where useful.

decks.title: Spanish: Travel Phrases
decks.description: For beginning travelers: complete phrases for greetings, transport, lodging, meals, shopping, and asking for help. English meanings explain when to use each phrase.

decks.title: SQL: Queries, Joins, Functions
decks.description: For SQL beginners practicing queries, filters, joins, aggregation, subqueries, functions, and data changes. Examples favor standard SQL; database-specific syntax and NULL behavior are noted where relevant.

decks.title: Swift: Language Essentials
decks.description: For beginning Swift developers reviewing values, optionals, collections, functions, types, protocols, error handling and concurrency. Original examples focus on stable language fundamentals.

decks.title: US Constitution: Articles and Amendments
decks.description: For beginning civics learners reviewing the seven articles, all 27 ratified amendments and basic constitutional structure. Summaries use the public constitutional text; verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: US Driver's Permit: Road Signs and Rules
decks.description: For U.S. permit learners: common sign meanings, right-of-way principles, and safe driving habits. State laws and exceptions differ; consult your current state handbook and verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: US History: Presidents in Order
decks.description: For beginning US history learners: presidents numbered 1 through 47, with years, party and one key fact. Nonconsecutive presidencies receive separate cards. Current term information is dated October 9, 2026.

decks.title: Geography: US States, Capitals, Abbreviations
decks.description: For geography beginners learning all 50 U.S. states: recall each state capital and its two-letter USPS postal abbreviation. Includes states only, with one clear prompt per state.

decks.title: US Citizenship: 100 Civics Questions (2008 version)
decks.description: For learners using the 2008 USCIS civics test: 100 official questions and accepted answers. State-specific answers need personalization; officeholders need rechecking. Confirm your required test version and verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: USMLE Step 1: Microbiology
decks.description: For medical learners reviewing bacteria, viruses, fungi, parasites, and microbial mechanisms for Step 1. Educational review only; verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: USMLE Step 1: Pathology Basics
decks.description: For medical students reviewing Step 1: core injury mechanisms, inflammation, neoplasia and classic organ-system pathology. Educational review only; verify with current guidelines.

decks.title: Geography: World Capitals (195 countries)
decks.description: For geography beginners: capitals of the 193 UN member states plus the Holy See and Palestine. Notes distinguish shared, disputed, and transitional capital arrangements. Reference date: October 2026.

decks.title: Geography: Flags Described in Words
decks.description: For geography beginners practicing national flag designs in words. Covers colors, stripe order, crosses, stars, and emblems; civil and state variants are distinguished where relevant. Hoist means the pole side.

decks.title: World History: 200 Key Dates
decks.description: For world-history learners connecting major events with dates and brief context across regions and eras. Ancient dates are approximate where indicated, and traditional dates are identified as such.

decks.title: Geography: Rivers, Mountains, Landmarks
decks.description: For geography beginners: identify major rivers, mountain ranges, peaks, and natural or cultural landmarks around the world. Boundary-dependent superlatives are qualified and alternative names are included where useful.
